customManagers.description: Renovate's npm manager skips the govue pnpm git dependency (skipReason unversioned-reference) because of its '&path:/web' suffix. This manager reads the tag out of web/package.json so the npm half is updated like any other dependency.

packageRules.description: A govue release is one tag with a Go module and an npm package. Both halves move in one pull request, because task check:govue-version refuses a repository that pins them to different tags. Renovate cannot regenerate web/pnpm-lock.yaml for the custom manager: run 'pnpm install --lockfile-only' in web/ on the branch and push the result.
prBodyNotes: Manual step: Renovate cannot update `web/pnpm-lock.yaml` for this group. Run `pnpm install --lockfile-only` in `web/` on this branch, check that the govue entry still carries `path: /web`, and push the result.

packageRules.description: TypeScript stays below 7 until typescript-eslint and vue-tsc support it: typescript-eslint rejects 7.0 at import and vue-tsc 3.x needs typescript/lib/tsc, which 7 no longer exports. Remove this rule when both release 7 support.
